source_records.title: Code and Data for "Experimental Analysis of the Dorabella Cipher with Statistical Language Models", HistoCrypt 2021

source_records.role: Live community challenge status and display transcription
source_records.status_scope: Listed as having no accepted systematic decipherment, not proof about every private proposal

primary_archive.extraction: Previously read directly by streamed tarfile from normal-TLS archive response; same87 characters shown by live challenge.
primary_archive.archive_limit: Streaming archive inspection stopped after31.857 seconds; entire archive checksum was not recomputed. No third-party code, model or corpus vendored.

source_record_scope: Reuse the prior acquired source snapshots and exact author member; not a new live status audit.
algorithm_scope: Independent stdlib implementation of exact sparse quadgram key-swap deltas and single-process logical replica exchange; not new historical cryptanalysis.
assumptions: Original author flattened stream, no rearrangement or inserted words.
One glyph maps to one English letter; distinct glyphs map to distinct letters.
Existing frozen English corpus and its quadgram table; no target phrases or neural fitting.
Full 26-letter permutations include arbitrary mappings for six unobserved glyph labels.
English fitness and exact forward replay do not establish historical correctness.

bounds.work_unit: One actual swap proposal including greedy polish; not a distinct key. Affected windows, exchange attempts and full rescoring are counted separately.
bounds.global_wall_scope: Search calls and checkpointing after corpus initialization; cooperative solver checks can add batch and result-finalization overhead.

run.fitness: existing English quadgram log fitness, not correctness probability
run.operation_definition: One proposal evaluates one bijective key swap; repeated states allowed. Exchanges, full scores and affected windows counted separately.
run.wall_limit_scope: Cooperative batch checks; model/topology initialization and final result serialization can add overhead.

pre_campaign_performance_pilot.scope: Performance pilot on an earlier draft with the same default objective, before this frozen main campaign. Full source byte hash and full key were not retained, so it is not a forward-verified frozen witness.

control_selection_note: The initial 87-letter courier exact-recovery test failed. A separate original prose prefix was then measured and retained as a passing regression; it has fewer distinct letters and is not an accuracy benchmark. An 88-letter harbor trial recovered 84 positions; a 146-letter courier extension recovered 138; a 120-letter meeting narrative recovered exactly. Those exploratory fixture runs had the same 180000-proposal upper cap, no target-specific score fitting, and were not part of this checkpointed campaign. Exact exploratory counts were not retained.

heldout_verification.reason: No independently sourced Dorabella plaintext or key acquired. Guessed words cannot serve as heldout truth.
